items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: the man down there who hired me, Chuck Fowler, tape recorded it

ctx.x: The funny part of it is, in that concert I couldn't hear them at all where I was sitting. And I decided that that was the last concert I'll ever play without having a monitor speaker on the stage, you know. For me and one for the drummer so that we can hear everybody because it's, certain currents go certain ways and if you're caught in the crossfire, sometimes you can't hear certain people.

And I could not hear the soloists at all in that job. And I heard them when I came home on a little bit of tape that Anita made from a video tape because the machine wasn't working, a battery or something, but the man down there who hired me, Chuck Fowler, tape recorded it so I'll be able to hear it.
